name: OSHA inspections and penalties by state and industry (DOL enforcement data)
description: How many workplace safety inspections OSHA opened in each state and industry, how many ended in citations, how many violations were found (serious, willful, repeat) and the current penalties, from the Department of Labor's OSHA enforcement files (federal and state-plan), by fiscal year: the latest year and the ten-year window, for the US, every state and territory with inspections, and each state's NAICS sectors. Only counts and dollar totals: no employer, address or inspection number is in the dataset.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). OSHA inspections and penalties by state and industry (DOL enforcement data) (Version 1.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23850661

distribution.name: osha-enforcement.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: osha-enforcement.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

recordSet.name: osha-enforcement
recordSet.description: The records of OSHA inspections and penalties by state and industry (DOL enforcement data), one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: US or the two-letter state or territory code

field.name: level
field.description: us, state or industry (a state or the US within one NAICS sector)

field.name: area
field.description: US, the state code, or <state code>-<NAICS sector> such as TX-23

field.name: areaName
field.description: Area name

field.name: sector
field.description: NAICS two-digit sector (all for whole-state rows; unclassified when the file gave none)

field.name: year
field.description: The latest federal fiscal year (October to September) in the file

field.name: fiscalYears
field.description: The ten-fiscal-year window of the 10y columns

field.name: status
field.description: P published; the latest year is marked preliminary because citations can follow inspections for up to six months

field.name: inspections
field.description: OSHA inspections opened in the latest fiscal year (federal and state-plan)

field.name: inspections10y
field.description: The same, summed over the ten-year window

field.name: inspectionsWithCitations
field.description: Inspections that ended with at least one citation

field.name: violations
field.description: Citation items issued on inspections opened in the year

field.name: serious
field.description: Of the violations, classified serious

field.name: willful
field.description: Of the violations, classified willful

field.name: repeat
field.description: Of the violations, classified repeat

field.name: currentPenalties
field.description: Current penalties in US dollars: the amount after later contest and settlement changes, as the DOL file reports it

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
